name: Default
shortDescription: Database explorer and ERD tool to design, document and analyze large database schemas, with PostgreSQL and local project storage.

alerts.message: Anyone who can reach the URL can sign up. No email service is configured, so email confirmation is skipped and password reset emails are not sent; add an EMAIL_ADAPTER (smtp, mailgun or gmail) to enable them.

Without a LICENCE_KEY from Azimutt, organizations only get the free plan: projects can be explored but not saved, and layouts hold at most 10 tables. Add LICENCE_KEY to the azimutt service to unlock the paid plans.
Connecting to a live database goes through the Azimutt gateway: run it locally with npx azimutt@latest gateway, or set GATEWAY_URL to a gateway you host.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
